title: Ryugyong Hotel
visualBrief: Compact Ryugyong exterior preserves all mapped radial wings, their sloping roofs and setbacks, separate central shaft, conical crown and podium. Low tiers coarsen facade grids and crown rings; original master remains reproducible.

geographicProposal.notes: One inspected daylight exterior photograph confirms the blue-gray three-wing pyramid, narrow ribs, intermediate outer-wing shoulders and conical ringed crown. Preserve original330m height, concave mapped podium, separate central shaft and mapped wing roof directions77/197/317degrees. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the tower/plaza and surrounding roads. Off-podium PMTiles point[0,150]26.1845m sets approximate ground contact; center36.7994m remains coarse. Bounded rectangular preview correction covers the large podium while retaining raw heights separately. Facade panel schedule, precise shoulder heights, crown ring sections, podium entrances and thresholds remain approximations. The2012 picture does not certify current LED/display installations or occupancy.
